headline: UDR (UDR) Could Be 4% Undervalued On Raised 2026 Guidance
summary: Why UDR stock is back in focus after new guidance UDR (UDR) drew fresh attention after issuing new earnings guidance for the third quarter of 2026 and lifting its full year 2026 net income outlook, providing clearer visibility for shareholders. The company now expects third quarter 2026 net income of $0.13 to $0.15 per diluted share. For the full year 2026, UDR raised its guidance range to $1.03 to $1.11 per diluted share, compared with its earlier forecast of $0.91 to $1.01. See our latest...
